problem_type: Competing design content can impersonate a successful selected-design switch
symptom: Both design-switch receipts accept identical first-shot prompt, so an updated selected row with stale editor content can pass.
direct_cause: Fixture shot prompts omit their unique plan/shot identity; completion checks presence only and never rejects foreign design content.
class_root: A UI selection receipt does not bind production selected identity to distinct target content and the absence of foreign content in the same completion observation.
affected_population: All small/typical/heavy competing fixture designs and future plan-switch actions
Selected target row with stale-only or target-plus-foreign editor content
entry_points: Shared completion predicate and all scale fixture constructors
invariants: Every competing fixture shot has unique identity-bearing visible content at every scale
Completion requires exact active production design ID, target prompt and absence of every foreign design prompt simultaneously
Public DOM identity/content/exclusion and complete persisted shot assertions remain
A stale-content positive control and wrong selected identity cannot complete
Unknown or duplicate narrow-run arguments fail before fixture/app setup; only the two affected actions rerun

door_reduction.why_not: Keep the existing fixture consumers and shared browser observation callers; content identity and exclusion are enforced at their shared boundaries without creating another fixture or runner.

generality_proof: All three fixture scales now expose unique shotId in every prompt. The shared browser predicate applies textNot in the same frame as target presence and exact selected-row identity. Node positive control reproduces changed selection with stale-only and target-plus-stale content, then proves success only when old content is removed. The common design loop serves both full and strictly selected two-action runs; existing three-suite mandatory CI/local evidence gate includes these regressions.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Provide uniquely attributable visible plan/shot content at every scale
Bind trusted-input completion to target identity/content and foreign-content exclusion

same_class_entry_points.evidence: One shared loop records exact selected production ID, unique target shot/prompt and all foreign prompts; complete persisted plans remain asserted
No storyboard content-completion predicate; historical baseline remains immutable and fixture hash change is disclosed
Existing distinct Workflow draft content and exact active document ID; no assertion weakened

recurrence.reason: Any competing target whose content is shared or retained can impersonate selection; every scale and shared completion caller must preserve attribution.
same_class_scan: rg Workflow fixture shot / storyboard.switch / completion conditions across fixture and Nomi runners

prevention.invariant: Selected identity, distinct target content and foreign exclusion agree in the same browser observation.
prevention.failure_mode: Probe never completes and existing bounded timeout fails; unknown narrow-run arguments throw before setup.
prevention.strategy: Identity-bearing shared fixture prompts plus shared negative content predicate; common two-action loop retains public and disk assertions. Existing explicitly registered three-suite check:nomi-workflow-evidence is structural enforcement in this PR: CI/local exact argv executes both changed class regressions; no general selector or gate is bypassed.

legacy_paths.rationale: Repeated shared prompts and presence-only design completion are replaced; original raw two-action false-green claims are withdrawn without rewriting evidence.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal fixture/receipt attribution defect; no dependency or production change.

migration: No production/store/data/concurrency/budget migration. Unique fixture content changes one historical baseline source hash; baseline numbers are not relabeled as a current-source measurement.
residual_risks: New-head CI pending after final normal push; final-source bounded real UI receipts passed and are archived
Four LazyMarkdown consumers still need runtime cold chunk/failure, suspended updates, streaming and close/reopen acceptance
Full performance matrix and real-display/Mac/Windows/GPU baselines remain unverified
internal_only_reason: Repository production data-active/ID and storyboard editor output are the real observable contracts. The offline fixture and browser probe are internal; no external API claim or dependency defect.
